articles.title: Faisal Islam: How high will interest rates go?
articles.description: The BBC's economics editor views one more interest rate as likely, but thinks that will be all.

articles.title: Married at First Sight UK cancelled after BBC revealed rape allegations
articles.description: Three women made allegations about the men they were partnered with. Channel 4 has apologised and said the show's budget would be reinvested  in "distinctive new programming".

articles.title: Vance walks Trump tightrope after blaming Iran war for election defeat
articles.description: The vice-president's blunt assessment of Republican election defeat marked one of the sharpest breaks with a sitting president in recent memory.

articles.title: Could this be the last Bonfire Night for noisy fireworks at home?
articles.description: About 20 million people enjoy fireworks at home every year, but some campaigners want quieter displays.
